name: Mangy Claw
summary: In Dun Morogh, Mangy Claw bears the mark of a deadly hunt. The great ice claw bear Mangeclaw killed a stranded dwarven pilot, and the severed claw proves the beast was slain.

sections.title: A Dying Pilot's Wish
sections.body: Pilot Hildelve’s steam tank broke down in Dun Morogh’s frozen hills, leaving him to search for ore on foot and face the mountain wilderness alone. His recovered journal tells how he fought off an ice claw bear named Mangeclaw, though the struggle left him savagely mauled. The bear returned later and killed the weakened pilot. In his final written entry, Hildelve pleaded for vengeance. Taking the Mangy Claw from the fallen bear fulfills that request.

sections.title: Vengeance for the Siege Brigade
sections.body: Pilot Hammerfoot sent searchers into the snowdrifts, hoping to find his friend Hildelve alive. The journal and Mangy Claw show Hammerfoot that Hildelve died and that his final request was honored. Bringing them to Hammerfoot gives the Ironforge Siege Brigade closure and earns the gratitude of Ironforge’s pilots.

faq.answer: Mangy Claw is a trophy taken from Mangeclaw, a savage ice claw bear in Dun Morogh. The severed claw proves the beast was hunted and killed.
Pilot Hammerfoot wants the Mangy Claw and the journal of his fallen friend Hildelve, to confirm the killer bear is dead. He is stationed near Dun Morogh’s mountain passes.

faq.q: Why did Mangeclaw need to be hunted?
faq.answer: Mangeclaw mauled and eventually killed Hildelve, a dwarf pilot searching for ore on foot after his steam tank broke down. Hildelve’s journal records his dying wish for someone to avenge him.

faq.q: Where does the beast Mangeclaw roam?
faq.answer: Mangeclaw prowls the snowy ridges and hills of Dun Morogh, not far from where Pilot Hildelve’s remains were found.

angles.text: As a dwarf, honoring a fallen comrade’s dying wish and avenging a member of the Ironforge Siege Brigade carries deep personal and clan honor.
As a hunter, tracking Mangeclaw through Dun Morogh’s brutal mountain blizzards tests your skill against dangerous, territorial beasts.
